_meta.description: Churches planted, in roughly the order they were planted. status: mature | growing | new.
_meta.needs: null if self-sustaining; otherwise { kind: building|pastor, goal, raised, label }

churches.note: The district-headquarters congregation. Meets in a rented hall; saving toward a permanent space.
Where the mission began. The first home gathering met here in 1980, and where Silpa came to faith as a child.
A built sanctuary serving the silk-trading town. Hosts the regional Bible study and youth gatherings.
Planted in a market town near the Andhra border; a steady, self-supporting congregation.
A farming community on the highway north. Worship under a tin roof beside the pastor's home.
A young congregation gathered from three nearby hamlets; meets weekly in a rented shopfront.
A village plant born out of evening prayer meetings. Many first-generation believers.
A small hill-fort town. The congregation walks in from surrounding hamlets for Sunday worship.
A roadside village along the Bangalore highway. Twelve families meet every Sunday in a home.
The newest plant. A home gathering of seven families; raising funds for a meeting hall.
